notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.content:
Like a pirate with new-found depth perception issues Neon Force Pushers is stumbling in with a new patch!
[list]
[*] Added new character skins! Each character now has a unique set of skins for you to select from!
[*] Added more controller hints! (They also stay out of each other's way now!)
[*] Fixed settings in Graphics Menu being un-navigable by controller. This was the last issue preventing NFP from having full controller support!
[*] Fixed the game being too dark when the graphics setting 'Terrain Emission' was set to off.
[*] Fixed custom controls not loading properly. You will no longer need to remap your controls every time you start the game!
[*] Fixed how analog sticks behaved in control menus. They were kinda sketchy before.
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/JsUWfjDwCf]Join the NFP Discord![/url]

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Woah! A new update? Today? Who could've known? Not me. Not with all the complications in this past week. I'll spare you the details until after the feature list of this new update!

[h2]Main features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New, extra shiny, graphics!
[*] Replaced old menus with a hub world!
[*] Replaced old character customization with character/skin selections!
[*] New music commissioned for Neon Force Pushers by [url=https://soundcloud.com/galgox]Googie[/url]!
[/list]

Do you like NFP? Want to chat with me, the developer, about NFP? Want to chat with others about NFP or schedule a remote play session? Join the NFP Discord! [url=https://discord.gg/wPzt3qQznR]Click here to join![/url]

A week and a half is the amount of prep time I gave myself to finish this update. I'm pretty surprised at all I was able to fit into this update in that time. Development was slow and I did not think NFP could be fixed in any short amount of time, and certainly not a week and a half.
I got a reminder email from Steam about an upcoming sale and the idea flew into my head to get the new update done in time for that sale, which was a week and a half away. I thought "Hey, why not? I have half a week to decide if it is possible and then I will announce the possibility if it could happen a week before."
I wanted God's opinion on it though, so I told him I was going to try this, but that I wanted his opinion on it. I never know if I'll get a response but I still try to talk to him. In this circumstance I didn't get any clear response and I continued with my plan. I was making good progress until couple of days from the deadline where I hit two roadblocks. All I could do was give them to God, and so I did, and the problems seemed to just melt away like hot butter. God is good, and I accredit this game to him!
There are still some bugs left that I know need to be fixed that I didn't have time to get rid of, but I got the most game breaking ones out! I'll release a patch this week fixing some of them.
One last thing, I mentioned that I wanted to know what God wanted me to do. Just yesterday I learned what it is he wants. He wants our thanks. It's not that he wants us to do any specific job, he just wants us to be thankful when he blesses us in what we do. Thank you God who provides answers when there are no answers, paths when there are no paths, and love when there is no love! Thank you God of all!

Thanks for reading and God bless you!

notes.title: I'm Not Dead Yet!
notes.content:
Blessings to you, Blaze the star here! It has been a long time since NFP was last updated, about half a year or so, and I have been wanting to let you all know what's been going on. Firstly, the game is not dead. These past months I've been working hard adding features, upgrading systems, and squashing bugs! In this post I will be telling you about what I’ve completed so far, more that I plan to release in this coming update, and what I plan for the update after that! Keep in mind some or all of this can be subject to change.

[h3]What’s been completed? (Upcoming v1.3.0)[/h3]

Firstly, a new hub-world will replace the old menus. Menus will be seamlessly integrated into the world with the use of ‘stations’. Enter a station and a menu will pop-up with any related options for that station. For example, enter a character station and you will get a menu allowing you to change characters, or enter a game station if you want to select a stage and play. The removal of the old menus also helps with my efforts to add full controller support to NFP since that was previously a difficult problem to solve.

Secondly, and this is probably where the majority of my time was spent, I have completely overhauled the visuals of the game. The terrain, objects, characters have all been redone, looking better than ever! I even added new backgrounds to the levels, adding new depth to the world! My words could never tell you how much different it is, so I will show rather than tell with the image below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32569701/6b4408fcba5c75ac4ddaa375d0c01afb79408d19.png[/img]

Last, but not least, music! Neon Force Pushers will finally have its own commissioned soundtrack done by Google… I mean Googie, with an i instead of an L. To get an idea of what the soundtrack will sound like [url=https://soundcloud.com/galgox/tracks]go listen to Googie’s music over on soundcloud[/url]! Some of my personal favorites from Googie are Licking The Moon, Kobold Spacefarer, Saber Spirit, Dusty Abode, and Streaks of Silver.

With all that, the list of things I still need to add is relatively small. I will implement a new character system to facilitate their new look and give them more expressive eyes! I will add full controller support, finalize the hub-world, and fix many bugs! I also may or may not add online functionality back into the game. If I don’t add it into this update I will add it to the next. What do you think? Should I add it sooner? Do you care? Let me know in the discussions below!

[h3]What’s next? (Future v1.4.0)[/h3]

In v1.4.0 I will be adding a story mode to NFP. The first of seven episodes will be added to the game for free with seven levels per episode. These levels will be linear 2D platformer sections with optional multiplayer coop and the same push mechanics we all know and love!... or at least tolerate. The story will follow the people who live in a place called the Cosmosect, a strange dimension with glowing walls, twisted space, and wonky gravity. This strange world has been colonized by grub-like pill creatures with animal features. Living spaces, industry, farms, and cities have all been established by them in this alien environment with supply lines to and from their native world. They live in relative peace until one day they are completely cut off from their native world. Panic plagues the inhabitants of the Cosmosect and in the chaos a militant faction rises, establishing a total dictatorship wherever they hold control. I would say more, but I don’t want to spoil the story too much. For now we will just move on to the next topic.

👟SHOES! Play game, get shoes, more shoes, 👞 LOTSA SHOES!!!.........  👟👞👟👞👞👟👞👟👟
trade shoes, 👟 use shoes in shop...  
Shop with shoes 😎 

With the shoes 👟 you collected in the previous lines it’s very important you don’t eschew the shop. In the shop you will be able to 👟 buy boxes with your shoes and in those boxes will be 👞 new characters, skins for your characters, and new wave effects! The shop is NOT as simple as trade shoes for boxes though, because there are different types of boxes and shoes! Red shoes, 👟 green shoes, blue shoes, and cashews! You will only be able to buy the box that corresponds to the shoes you have. All players will be rewarded all types of shoes for playing the game, but each player will receive one type of shoe more abundantly 👞than the other types. One player may get an abundance of red shoes, a different player 👟 may have an abundance of green shoes, and they would be able to trade shoes so that they can purchase the things they want from the shop quicker!

👞 👟👞 👟
At last this is the end! I have told you every plan! I have said EVERYTHING +1. There is nothing more to be 👟 said. Let me give you a blessing then I will leave you to your way. May the lord bless you and keep you! May he make his face to shine upon you and be gracious to you! May he lift up his countenance on you and give you his peace! In the name of Jesus! That's all, you are free to go, 👞👟👟 but before you do please 👟 take your shoes with you. They are completely cluttering my workspace and I need to get back to work. 👞 👟👞 👟👞 👟👞 👟👞 👟

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
If you update a game and it replaces every piece code, is it still the same game? I don't know, but Neon Force Pushers is updated today! While very few new features were actually added, a lot of work was put into improving the game's quality. Many textures have been remade, the controls made more responsive, and the performance improved drastically. Really, this is how the game should have been from the start and I made a huge mistake releasing it in the state that it was in. We are here now though! :D Here's are some things you can expect from this new update.

[list]
[*] Character design changed to have shoes! They are now a lot more expressive!
[*] Character animations now have more squish and stretch!
[*] Create your own oc in the character creator! The features of which are not complete however.
[*] Controls have been made more responsive.
[*] Performance is greatly improved. Most computers should be able to play it fine.
[*] Mac support is no more. Sorry Mac. :(
[*] You now can be in multiple places at once while standing on the edge of the screen. Visuals now wrap around the screen.
[*] Textures have been changed to be more smooth!
[*] Feeling lonely? Want to have friends? I can't help with that, but you can now have fun alone with the single player challenges!
[*] The Pause screen is now a thing! Press [i]Escape[/i] to pause your game when you want throw off your opponents! ;)
[*] Mock your opponents with the new crouch feature! You might as well as it serves no other purpose...
[*] I've received complaints regarding the A.I. so I removed it. You can't complain about a feature that doesn't exist. :)
[*] Connecting to a friend's game by their IP address is no longer possible. It's easier to just use remote play anyways.
[/list]
